text:
sophie: Quick sync — merchant account setup across AWS/GCP/Azure. Need final SKU->offer mapping, IAM trust anchors for publisher portals, and any legal EULA tweaks. Can we triage today? :wave:
dan: Can we get a concrete list of accounts and owner emails? I'm blocked without owner IAM access.
ali: AWS publisher account: 123456789012 (owner: aws-pub@redwood.com). GCP billing project: redwood-marketplace-prod (sa: gcp-pub-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com). Azure tenant: redwood.onmicrosoft.com (app id: a1b2c3d4).
marco: For Azure we need Partner Center invite sent from our MSA. I can send it today — who is the contact?
jen: FYI legal has minor language changes for trial terms — see summary below. We need to decide if trial converts to paid automatically (opt-out) or manual opt-in.
legal-bot: LEGAL NOTE: Modify marketplace EULA clause 4.2 to add 'trial period ends X days' and link to privacy page. Approvals required from @jen and @sophie.
sophie: Let's go opt-in for trials — customers must opt-in to billing.
dan: OK opt-in. Also, recs for SKU naming: use <product>-<tier>-<region> e.g., inference-pro-us
marco: Good. On IAM/trust anchor: AWS needs cross-account role with external ID. Can someone paste the tf snippet?
ali: Pasting minimal TF role we use (remove keys):
```hcl
resource "aws_iam_role" "marketplace_publisher" {
  name = "redwood-marketplace-pub"
  assume_role_policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17",
    Statement = [{
      Action = "sts:AssumeRole",
      Effect = "Allow",
      Principal = { AWS = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:root" }
    }]
  })
}
```
sophie: That looks right. Dan, can you add external_id and tags matching SKU mapping?
dan: Yup will add external_id = "marketplace-1747" and tags { "sku-group" = "inference-pro" } and push to infra repo.
ali: For GCP we need a service account with roles/compute.admin + roles/iam.serviceAccountUser and an OIDC trust for listing automation.
marco: Azure requires app registration + delegated admin consent. I can draft the invite text.
jen: Product images — we need hero + 3 thumbnails, 1200x628 and 300x300. Marketing to deliver by EOD tomorrow. @sophie please confirm branding tone.
sophie: Approve current hero but please remove the 'beta' badge. Marketing: @marco, @jen liaise.
offline: tax/billing contact — ping finance (cc: finance@redwood.com) for VAT handling in EU.
sophie: Owners & next steps:
- dan: create cross-account role + push TF
- ali: create GCP SA + share key via secrets manager
- marco: send Azure Partner Center invite + draft message
- jen: finalize legal text + EULA patch
- marketing: images by EOD tomorrow
Ping back here when done. :thumbsup:
dan: I'll create PR today and tag @sophie for review.
ali: I'll provision SA and add IAM bindings, will post the service account email when done.
marco: Invite queued, sending now — will paste Partner Center link here once accepted.
jen: Legal PR ready, but will wait for marketing images before finalizing screenshots.
sophie: Thanks everyone — quick huddle at 4pm in #partnerships if any blockers. :calendar:
